programme.title: De Garde van Gert
programme.desc: Gert Verhulst staat vandaag in de keuken met stoere chef Dominique Persoone. Een ruwe bolster met een blanke pit, want vandaag maakt de chef de specialiteit van zijn mama: een Franse salade met warme ingrediënten.

programme.title: De Sterrenkaart - Nederland
programme.desc: Restaurant RIJKS werd in 2016 bekroond met een Michelinster. Met zijn lokale keuken brengt Joris Bijdendijk een ode aan de Nederlandse eetcultuur. De chef vertelt over de harde weg richting de top en laat zijn favoriete tips en tricks zien.

programme.title: De Eregast
programme.desc: Dominique nodigt als eerste gast de Godfather van de Belgische gastronomie uit: Peter Goossens. Met gezonde zenuwen serveren de boys hun drie gangen. Een Parmigiano glassata, daarna varkensvlees aan het spit en als dessert Boules de Berlin.

programme.title: Indian Summer
programme.desc: De bandleden van Goose schuiven aan voor een American style barbecue met jalapeño pickle bags, krab New Orleans style, USA-style BBQ en pulled pork. En Dominique daagt hen ook nog uit voor een rondje lassowerpen.

programme.title: Indian Summer
programme.desc: De bandleden van Goose schuiven aan voor een American style barbecue met jalapeño pickle bags, krab New Orleans style, USA-style BBQ en pulled pork. En Dominique daagt hen ook nog uit voor een rondje lassowerpen.

programme.title: Loïc zot van koken weekmenu
programme.desc: Met elke keer een nieuw weekmenu.

programme.title: Vanavond bij ons
programme.desc: Sarah en Loïc koken voor elkaar en hun vrienden. Iets wat ze, verrassend genoeg, nog nooit deden. Op het menu: het appeltaartje waarmee Sarah ooit Loïcs hart veroverde en hun bekende Snackmaster-pizza, maar dan in een compleet nieuw jasje.

programme.title: Vlaamse Klassiekers
programme.desc: Lynn laat zich vandaag verrassen door de steak tartaar van chef Vadim, hét signatuurgerecht bij Monroe in Antwerpen. Daarna vertoeft ze aan het zeetje voor de verse garnaalkroketten of 'Noordzeeklompjes' van chef Stijn in De Kruidenmolen.

programme.title: Sarah's Sweet Table
programme.desc: Sarah bakt vandaag zelfgebakken brood. Ze maakt een luchtig briochebrood met crème patissière en een laagje karamel. Daarna bakt ze de klassieke flantaart, een echte bestseller in haar patisseriezaak. De sleutel tot succes: keep it simple!

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Van een heerlijk krokante cordon bleu met smeuïge kaassaus tot verse pappardelle met langzaam gegaarde lamsschouder: Timon trakteert ons vandaag op twee van zijn favoriete comfortfood-gerechten, met het allerbeste vlees als smaakmaker.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.sub-title: Het Weekmenu - Winterse Kost van Wim Ballieu
programme.desc: Wim is een echte fan van Winterse Kost en houdt ervan om winterklassiekers zijn eigen draai te geven. Vandaag is dat moussaka met een krokant korstje, Wims versie van de vol-au-vent, cordon bleu met smeuïge puree en een broodje coq au vin.

programme.title: Open Vuur
programme.desc: De dag start vandaag all'italiana met Bistecca Fiorentina en pizza van Sarah. West-Vlaamse boys Tom en Dominique proberen ondertussen hun schaapjes op een rij te houden in de schaapskooi en bereiden nog een lam Asado style op Open Vuur.

programme.title: Wild van Wild
programme.desc: Chef Jan Buytaert gaat op zoek naar wild dat in de vrije natuur heeft geleefd en gegeten. Samen met wildexpert Gert Michiels maakt Jan een tocht door het Vlaamse landschap op zoek naar patrijs.

programme.title: Indian Summer
programme.desc: De bandleden van Goose schuiven aan voor een American style barbecue met jalapeño pickle bags, krab New Orleans style, USA-style BBQ en pulled pork. En Dominique daagt hen ook nog uit voor een rondje lassowerpen.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: Simpel, maar goed. Zo heeft Bart zijn winterse kost het liefst. Zoals bij zijn tartiflette met prei, kaas en spek of zijn stoofpotje van varken en zuurkool. Daarnaast is de chef ook fan van een lekker stukje vis in de winter.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Van een heerlijk krokante cordon bleu met smeuïge kaassaus tot verse pappardelle met langzaam gegaarde lamsschouder: Timon trakteert ons vandaag op twee van zijn favoriete comfortfood-gerechten, met het allerbeste vlees als smaakmaker.

programme.title: Guillaume's Paris
programme.desc: De Franse chef-kok Guillaume Brahimi keert vanuit Australië terug naar Parijs, de stad waar hij opgroeide. Door middel van een culinaire reis door de twintig arrondissementen van de stad vertelt hij het verhaal van eten.

programme.title: Indian Summer
programme.desc: Tom en Dominique verwennen hun vrienden van de strandcabines in Zeebrugge met een groene punch met gin, palingbrochettes met merguez en kip met sinaasappel en Ricard. En uiteraard staat er ook een nachtelijke plons in zee op het programma.

programme.title: Open Vuur
programme.desc: De dag start vandaag all'italiana met Bistecca Fiorentina en pizza van Sarah. West-Vlaamse boys Tom en Dominique proberen ondertussen hun schaapjes op een rij te houden in de schaapskooi en bereiden nog een lam Asado style op Open Vuur.

programme.title: Over (h)eerlijke groenten
programme.desc: Johan Segers is vandaag te gast bij Ben van De Pleynhoeve, een aspergeteler uit Herentals. Op het menu staan asperges met snijbonen en tempura van asperges. Daarna serveert Johan de asperges met morieljes, garnalen en kwarteleitjes.

programme.title: Taste of Australia met Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden is in Brisbane en gaat op jacht naar epische paddenstoelen die in de stad worden gekweekt, leert over de wijngeschiedenis van Brisbane bij City Winery en praat bij met chef-kok Louis Tikaram.

programme.title: Vanavond bij ons
programme.desc: Loïc duikt in de kruidige wereld van Sri Lankaanse curry's en neemt ons mee op een culinaire reis naar het Oosten. Sarah stuurt onze smaakpapillen op reis naar Italië met een dessert geïnspireerd op de beste cannoli die ze ooit proefde.

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: De meiden starten hun dag in het Venetië van het Noorden met een ritje per koets. Lynn scoort heerlijke chocola, Tess en Maud duurzame koffie. Daarna wagen ze zich nog aan een miniworkshop glasblazen. Brugge op zijn leukst.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: In zijn geboortestad Caernarfon duikt chef Chris Flamebaster in de culinaire tradities van Noord-Wales. Hij maakt een smakelijke steak- en oestertaart, verrukkelijke broodjes met borststuk en een gebarbecuede makreelgerecht.

programme.title: Becoming Meewis
programme.desc: Intieme inkijk in de keuken van tweesterrenrestaurant De Slagmolen, waar vader en zoon Bert en Giel Meewis samen met hun team hun topproducten, verfijnde gerechten en dagelijkse keukenritme onthullen.

programme.title: De Gezonde Goesting
programme.desc: Steffi serveert de perfecte brunchgerechtjes: een vegan roerei met nep-spek, een snelle worteldip en als dessert een chocolademousse met twee ingrediënten. Ook haalt ze eco-deco in huis en geeft ze tips voor de mooiste foodfotografie.

programme.title: Toasted on wheels!
programme.desc: Dominique en Dagny Ros openen hun foodtruck vandaag in het hartje van Gent. Vandaag staan bloemkooltortilla's, vissticks met hummus en havermoutwafels op het menu.

programme.title: Ware Delicatessen
programme.desc: Chef Bart Desmidt gaat aan de slag met ingrediënten die als een ware delicatesse worden beschouwd. Met deze ingrediënten maakt hij bijzondere gerechten iedereen zou kunnen maken in beperkte tijd. Deze keer maakt hij gebruik van kreeft.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: In Swansea ontdekt Chris vurige smaken van Jamaicaanse kip, vlamgrillt hij verse vis aan het strand en kookt hij met jonge culinaire talenten.

programme.title: De Eregast
programme.desc: Peppe, Dominique en Jeroen zitten op hete kolen want ze ontvangen vandaag een culinaire vrouw in hun midden. Sepideh Sedaghatnia: wijnsommelier en eigenares van haar eigen gastrobar. Zij krijgt vandaag drie heerlijke gangen voorgeschoteld.

programme.title: Wild van Wild
programme.desc: Chef Jan Buytaert gaat op zoek naar wild dat in de vrije natuur heeft geleefd en gegeten. Samen met wildexpert Gert Michiels maakt Jan een tocht door het Vlaamse landschap op zoek naar patrijs.

programme.title: Open Vuur
programme.desc: Dit keer maken de grillmasters een 'kapsalon' Open Vuur Style klaar. Ook de visliefhebber komt aan zijn trekken met een portie zeeduivel. Tot slot wordt een kwartel met veel liefde op de barbecue gezwierd.

programme.title: Sarah's Sweet Table
programme.desc: Sarah is dol op karamel! Vandaag staan er twee zalig zoete desserts met karamel op haar Sweet Table te blinken: een luchtige cake met gekaramelliseerde ananas en chocoladetoffees in een nostalgische snoepverpakking. Een heerlijke plakboel!

programme.title: Peppe's Sicilië
programme.desc: Peppe's tafelgast vandaag is Gerlando. Hij is de beste vriend van zijn vader, een geweldige kok en hij is vooral verliefd op de zee. Gerlando en Peppe maken samen mosselen en zee-egels.

programme.title: Apero - Dining

programme.desc: Vandaag doet de winterse kost van Bart het werk voor hem. Hij maakt een hotpot klaar van rijst, zeeduivel en winterse groentjes. Alles in één grote pot en lekker laten pruttelen in de oven.

programme.title: Hidden Gems
programme.desc: Oom Tue is een doorgewinterde chef-kok die eigenaar is van een klein streetfood-restaurant in Petchaburi dat 's nachts echt tot leven komt. Hij verwerkt diverse culinaire vaardigheden uit het hele land.

programme.title: Toasted!
programme.sub-title: Green Velvet / Vintage Cake / Cute Quiche
programme.desc: Zoals altijd zweert Dagny Ros bij de gezonde keuken, terwijl Dominique voor ontbijtgerechten gaat om de kater door te spoelen. Dat bewijst Dominique vandaag eens te meer met zijn Vintage Cake.

programme.title: Vanavond bij ons
programme.desc: Een avondje bankhangen met de sappige hamburgers van Loïc, die druipen bij elke hap en een prachtige portie verloren brood, afgewerkt met een krokante crumble en een zalige zoete saus van Sarah. Broeksknoop los en genieten van comfortfood!

programme.title: Puur Oosters - Japans

programme.desc: Chef Ivan maakt één van de populairste eenpansgerechten uit Japan klaar: Tara Chiri Nabe, wat staat voor een eenpansgerecht met kabeljauw of skrei die in een hete pot op tafel wordt bereid, door hem te garen in een smakelijke bouillon.

programme.title: Goedemorgen Drenthe
programme.desc: Fris opstaan, met een overzicht van het laatste nieuws, de weersvooruitzichten en het verkeer. Judith Regendorp spreekt iedere ochtend een speciale gast, waarna belevenissen en verhalen uit de regio volgen.

programme.title: Koffie en Keuvelen
programme.desc: Programma met in het eerste uur muziek van Nederlandse bodem. Daarna neemt Wim een kopje koffie erbij om lekker te keuvelen. Luisteraars kunnen bellen met de studio en 'Op Tjak' doet verslag vanuit de regio.

programme.title: Drenthe Beweegt Samen
programme.desc: Blijf fit en beweeg mee met Drenthe beweegt samen! Een dagelijks tv-programma voor Drenten die fit willen blijven. Met oefeningen en tips. Elke werkdag even na tien uur op TV Drenthe.

programme.title: Koffie en Keuvelen
programme.desc: Programma met in het eerste uur muziek van Nederlandse bodem. Daarna neemt Wim een kopje koffie erbij om lekker te keuvelen. Luisteraars kunnen bellen met de studio en 'Op Tjak' doet verslag vanuit de regio.

programme.title: Anouk in de Middag
programme.desc: Anouk brengt sfeer en gezelligheid en praat de luisteraar bij over het laatste nieuws. Daarnaast draait ze muziek, geeft ze tips en wordt er een spelletje gespeeld. Op Tjak meldt zich ergens uit de provincie.

programme.title: Studio Steenbergen
programme.desc: René draait in het eerste uur van zijn programma hits uit de jaren zestig en zeventig. Daarna bespreekt hij hoe het in de showbizz gaat, wordt er een spelletje gespeeld en komen tips voor theater en film aan bod.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Revenge
programme.desc: Some films are best served cold, so wrap up and join us as we dive into our favourite revenge movies - from new hits to Oscar-winning classics. We hope you're ready for action.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster, which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of their small New England town. Part one of a two-part Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Bill Skarsgard, Jaeden Lieberher and Sophia Lillis.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan.

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: A writer takes a caretaking job at a remote mountain hotel. It has closed for the winter, and he has been hired to get the place ready for the next season. But evil spirits haunting its corridors destroy his sanity, causing the unhinged author to rampage through the hotel and terrorise his wife and young son. Stanley Kubrick's horror, based on the Stephen King novel, with Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Danny Lloyd and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Prequel to the acclaimed horror tale, in which a band of Western outlaws and unfortunate travellers stumble across a remote bar inhabited by suspicious looking characters _ who turn out to be vampires. Marco Leonardi, Michael Parks and Temuera Morrison star.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson.

programme.title: Beast of War
programme.desc: A group of soldiers get stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean after their ship is sunk, and must battle a great white shark. Writer/director Kiah Roache-Turner's horror thriller, starring Mark Coles Smith and Joel Nankervis.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: A parapsychologist returns to her family home to investigate supernatural disturbances. Fourth instalment in the horror saga, starring Lin Shaye, Angus Sampson, Leigh Whannell and Spencer Locke.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: After African American photographer Chris and his white girlfriend Rose visit her wealthy parents, he suspects there's more to the locals than meets the eye. Oscar-winning psychological thriller written and directed by Jordan Peele (Us), starring Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford and Caleb Landry Jones.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them. Supernatural horror, starring Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy and Natalie Grace.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Andy and his visually impaired younger stepsister Piper discover their father dead in the shower. Single mother Laura agrees to take in Andy and Piper until the traumatised youngster comes of age and can apply for legal guardianship of his stepsister. Hoever, when events inside Laura's home spiral out of control, Andy fears he is losing his mind. Thriller, starring Billy Barratt, Sora Wong and Sally Hawkins.

programme.title: Him
programme.desc: Cameron Cade is predicted to be the next great quarterback of American football. During a night-time training session, he suffers a traumatic brain injury. Cameron agrees to attend a week-long boot camp run by retiring star quarterback Isaiah White at his secluded desert compound. However, Cade's life soon turns into a nightmare. Supernatural horror, starring Marlon Wayans and Tyriq Withers.

programme.title: Weapons
programme.desc: At 2.17am, 17 children from the class of Justine Gandy run into the night, arms outstretched, never to be seen again. The only child from the class who remains safely in their bed is Alex Lilly. Distraught parent Archer Graff joins other members of the local community in pointing a finger of blame at Ms Gandy for the shocking turn of events. While she pleads innocence, school principal Andrew Marcus seeks answers along with police officer Paul Morgan. Horror, starring Julia Garner, Josh Brolin and Alden Ehrenreich.

Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains

Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).

programme.title: Twice Upon a Yesterday
programme.desc: Victor Bukowski cheats on girlfriend Sylvia Weld, who rebounds and gets engaged to Dave Summers. Wishing he could undo his error, Victor happens upon two otherworldly trash collectors, who send him back in time. He uses the opportunity to woo Sylvia again, while making sure that an attractive woman catches Dave's eye. But his attraction to a waitress, Louise, could ruin Victor's plan to right things with Sylvia.

Approached later by athletics commission head Maj. Jason Scully and reporter Paul Clarke, Nick still declines to investigate. When another reporter is murdered and Paul is arrested, Nick gives way to Nora's plea and, with their fox terrier Asta, sets out to solve the murders.

programme.title: The Thin Man Goes Home
programme.desc: Famous retired detective Nick Charles (William Powell) takes his wife, Nora (Myrna Loy), and their dog, Asta, to visit Nick's parents in their small, quiet town. Determined that Nick's father respect Nick's profession, Nora urges him to find a crime to investigate, unaware that Nick's presence has already frightened spy Edgar Draque (Leon Ames) into action. After Nora buys a painting for Nick's birthday and the artist is murdered, Nick discovers that the murder is connected to espionage.

programme.title: Song of the Thin Man
programme.desc: Tommy Drake (Philip Reed), a musician aboard a gambling ship, is shot and killed while trying to break into a safe. Later, amateur sleuths Nick (William Powell) and Norah (Myrna Loy) receive a visit from Phil Brant, Drake's former boss and the main suspect in his murder. After they give Brant up to the authorities, they start digging around for clues. The pair question Brant's wife and one of Drake's musician colleagues until they start to piece together the intricate puzzle.

programme.title: Calling Dr. Kildare
programme.desc: Senior physician Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) sends his student, the overconfident intern James Kildare (Lew Ayres), to work in the dispensary with nurse Mary Lamont (Laraine Day). There, a man unwilling to go to emergency pleads with Kildare to examine his friend, who has been shot. Kildare treats and hides the wounded man, whom he learns is a murder suspect. Smitten by the victim's attractive sister, Rosalie (Lana Turner), Kildare offers to help prove her brother's innocence.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders).

programme.title: The Bad Man
programme.desc: After an outlaw, Pancho Lopez (Wallace Beery), steals cattle from the ranch of Gil (Ronald Reagan) and his uncle Henry (Lionel Barrymore), they face foreclosure to banker Hardy (Henry Travers). When Gil's old love, Lucia (Laraine Day), shows up, her husband (Tom Conway) wants to buy the land, believing there is oil on it. However, Pancho soon arrives and kidnaps everyone except Gil. Pancho realizes that Gil had previously saved his life, so he attempts to help Gil get back on track.

programme.title: Journey for Margaret
programme.desc: In the midst of war-torn London, American journalist John Davis (Robert Young) and his wife, Nora (Laraine Day), lose their unborn baby in a bombing raid. The resultant surgery leaves Nora barren, and, while she returns to the United States to recuperate, John stays in England. When he takes young orphans Margaret (Margaret O'Brien) and Peter (William Severn) under his wing, John decides that he wants to remove the children from harm's way and bring them home to America.

programme.title: Mr. Lucky
programme.desc: Joe Adams (Cary Grant) is as clever as they come. Certain that he'll be called up during World War II, Joe nabs the draft papers of a man who's been freed from service and leverages his position into a potentially lucrative scam. The captain of a commercial ship, Joe cons war volunteer Dorothy Bryant (Laraine Day) into believing that he's planning a fund drive for the troops. In fact, he's got something more devious in mind. But as Joe rethinks things, he finds his ruse is already in motion.

programme.title: Bride by Mistake
programme.desc: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has.

programme.title: The Locket

programme.title: All That Heaven Allows

After meeting old friend Lugo the Huge (Paul Newlan) in a cantina, Don Ricardo takes the advice of Padre Carlos (David Leonard) and gets a job on his land, disguised as a common laborer, biding his time until he can find evidence of Luerra's wrongdoing and challenge him.

programme.title: Terror in a Texas Town

Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice.

programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: In this original version of iconic game show "Family Feud," actor Richard Dawson plays host to two teams, each comprised of five family members, who try to match the answers given to survey questions asked to groups of people (typically 100 people in the group). The family that wins the game by being the first to reach a certain point total, either 200 or 300 depending on the rules at the time, advances to the bonus round, called Fast Money, for a chance to win thousands of dollars by answering more survey questions.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.
